blocked_by: M2260 admits execution design only no training
supersedes: running targeted configs without candidate checkpoint evaluation

public_gates: M2261 must design training execution without running training
M2261 must use exactly the M2259 training matrix
M2261 must keep the 5-profile x 3-seed matched panel
M2261 must keep candidate-checkpoint retention and selected-checkpoint evaluation
M2261 must keep ranking winner selection paper claims finite-window-vs-GRU and self-ID claims blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run PPO outside the pre-registered training runner
do not change actor observation contract
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: turns clean M2259 materialized configs into a bounded execution design without starting training
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no training rerun ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if M2259 matrix is incomplete
stop if execution design cannot preserve candidate checkpoint retention
stop if design would rank profiles before outcome localization
fallback_plan: route back to M2259 materialization repair if the matrix is incomplete
route to branch synthesis if execution design cannot stay bounded
route to task redesign if targeted reward repair should no longer be trained
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2260 audits M2259 as clean materialization

allowed_updates: M2261 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up execution manifest selected by the design
next_stage_criteria: output directory and task id are fixed

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2261 is execution design and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2261; no wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history or measured execution intervention is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If targeted training later fails, route to result audit and slice localization; do not weaken ranking or self-ID standards.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking paper-level result finite-window-vs-GRU conclusion or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: prepares one bounded execution of the targeted containment repair matrix

M2261 would rank profiles before outcome localization
M2261 would skip candidate checkpoint retention

hypothesis: A controlled execution design can run the M2259 targeted containment config matrix through the existing candidate-checkpoint runner without ranking or paper claims.
success_criteria: design references the M2259 training matrix
design fixes output dir task id next blocker and guardrails
no reset rollout measured execution training replay private holdout ranking paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 claim is made
failure_criteria: design uses a matrix other than M2259
design ranks profiles or selects a winner
design changes actor input contract or widens track_width

commands.name: design
commands.command: manual design over M2259 materialization artifacts

decision_rule: M2261 passes if it freezes a bounded targeted-containment training execution design without running training or ranking profiles.
